home.faqLede: Short answers about Cobreo, the modules, and getting started.

faq.question: What is Cobreo?
faq.answer: Cobreo is a software platform composed of modules. You turn on the ones your organization needs, and you can add more later.

faq.question: Which modules are available?
faq.answer: Modules cover CRM, events, satisfaction, booking, automation, sites and public pages, user portals, human resources, and finances. Cross-cutting capabilities — tasks, payments, calendar, import and export, AI analysis — stay available from one module to another.

faq.question: Can we start with a single module?
faq.answer: Yes. You begin with the module or modules you need, then turn on others as your organization evolves.

faq.question: Can you build a custom module?
faq.answer: Yes. We can develop a private module for your organization, or a plugin that other organizations can add as well.

faq.question: Where is the data hosted?
faq.answer: The application and your data are hosted in Canada.

faq.question: Which tools does Cobreo integrate with?
faq.answer: Cobreo connects to Google, Microsoft, and Stripe, according to what you turn on.

faq.question: How does pricing work?
faq.answer: You only pay for the modules activated in your organization. Details are shared in a demonstration, according to your needs.

faq.question: How do we get a demo?
faq.answer: Request a demo from the Contact page, or write to contact@cobreo.ca. We can then see how Cobreo fits the way you work.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: At Cobreo (cobreo.ca), we protect the personal information you share with us. This policy explains what we collect, why, and your rights under applicable Quebec and Canadian law, as well as GDPR principles where relevant.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body:
Cobreo is responsible for personal information processed through cobreo.ca.

Email: contact@cobreo.ca

Website: https://cobreo.ca

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
sections.body: We may collect: identity and contact details (name, email, phone, company) when you submit a form; the content of your messages or diagnostic answers; technical browsing data (IP address, device type, pages viewed) via cookies or analytics tools if you consent; and information needed to securely operate our internal tools.

sections.title: 3. Purposes
sections.body: We use your data to respond to inquiries, deliver our services, improve the site and our processes, maintain security, meet legal obligations, and — only with consent when required — measure audience or send relevant communications.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases and retention
sections.body:
Depending on context, processing relies on your consent, steps toward or performance of a contract, or our legitimate interests (security, service improvement), in line with applicable law.

We keep data only as long as needed for the purposes described, then delete or anonymize it unless a legal obligation requires otherwise.

sections.title: 5. Sharing and processors
sections.body:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with providers that help us host the site, send email, or run our infrastructure (e.g. hosting, database, messaging), only as needed and under appropriate confidentiality commitments.

Some providers may be located outside Quebec or Canada; when that happens, we take reasonable steps to protect your data.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body:
Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or withdrawal of consent. To exercise your rights: contact@cobreo.ca.

You may also file a complaint with the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec or another competent authority.

sections.title: 7. Connected mailbox
sections.body:
The Cobreo application (app.cobreo.ca) is separate from the cobreo.ca website. A client organization may connect one or more of its own mailboxes, Gmail or Outlook.

Cobreo requests read access and send access. With Gmail, the permissions are openid, the account email address, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly, and https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send. With Outlook, the permissions are Mail.Read and Mail.Send. Cobreo does not request permission to modify, label, or delete messages.

Cobreo reads each mailbox to display, on the record of a person already registered in that organization, a message in which a participant — other than one of those mailboxes — has exactly that person’s email address. The record shows the date, the participants, the subject, and the text. A message that matches no one is not copied into Cobreo and remains in the mailbox.

A person in the organization may reply from the record. When several mailboxes are connected, that person chooses the sending address. Cobreo sends only that text, from that address. Cobreo does not send a message on its own initiative.

This data is used only for these functions, which are visible in the application. Cobreo does not sell it, does not use it for advertising, and does not disclose it to third parties, except to the providers that host the application, for security, or if the law requires it.

Use of data obtained through Google APIs complies with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Cobreo staff do not read these messages, except if the organization asks for help, if security requires it, or if the law requires it.

Disconnecting a mailbox stops further reads and further sends from that address. Messages already placed on a record remain that organization’s data. A request for access, correction, or deletion is made to contact@cobreo.ca.

Application data is hosted in Canada (Montreal region).

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.body: See our Cookie policy for categories and how to manage your choices.

sections.title: 9. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the current version. For material changes, we will adjust the on-site notice as needed.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using cobreo.ca or the Cobreo application (app.cobreo.ca), you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site or the application.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of the site
sections.body: The site presents Cobreo’s services and lets you contact us or start a diagnostic. Content is informational and is not personalized legal, financial, or technical advice until a separate agreement is in place.

sections.title: 2. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree to use the site lawfully, not to attempt to compromise its security, not to submit illegal or misleading content, and not to use abusive automated means (excessive scraping, spam).

sections.title: 3. Intellectual property
sections.body: Texts, trademarks, logos, designs, and other site elements belong to Cobreo or its licensors. Unauthorized reproduction is prohibited, except for reasonable personal non-commercial use.

sections.title: 4. Forms and communications
sections.body: Information you send must be accurate. We may refuse or ignore abusive requests. An exchange through the site does not automatically create a service contract.

sections.title: 5. Application and mailboxes
sections.body:
The application lets an organization connect one or more of its mailboxes, Gmail or Outlook. The organization authorizes Cobreo to read those mailboxes and to send, from the address a person in the organization chooses, the reply that person writes. Cobreo does not send a message on its own initiative.

The organization remains responsible for the content sent and for the choice of address. Disconnecting a mailbox stops further reads and further sends from that address.

sections.title: 6. Availability and liability
sections.body: We aim to keep the site available and accurate, without guaranteeing uninterrupted access or error-free content. To the extent permitted by law, Cobreo is not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the site.

sections.title: 7. Third-party links
sections.body: The site may link to third-party websites. We do not control their content and are not responsible for them.

sections.title: 8. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the applicable laws of Quebec and Canada. Disputes will be submitted to the competent courts of Quebec, subject to any mandatory rights you may have.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: Questions: contact@cobreo.ca

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This page explains how cobreo.ca uses cookies and similar technologies, and how you can manage your preferences.

sections.title: 1. What is a cookie?
sections.body: A cookie is a small file stored on your device. It may be required for the site to work, or used for analytics and experience improvements depending on your choices.

sections.title: 2. Categories we use
sections.body:
Essential: security, site delivery, remembering your consent and basic preferences. Always on.

Analytics: aggregate usage statistics and session replay (PostHog), only with your consent. Form fields and sensitive diagnostic content are masked in recordings.

Marketing: campaign or promotional measurement when applicable (only with your consent).

sections.title: 3. Legal basis and consent
sections.body: Non-essential cookies are set only after you consent via the banner. You can withdraw consent by clearing browser cookies or contacting us to reset preferences (clearing the local consent key).

sections.title: 4. Duration
sections.body: Duration varies by cookie (session or persistent). Your consent choice is stored locally on your device so we do not ask on every visit.

sections.title: 5. Managing your choices
sections.body: Use the cookie banner on first visit, or clear this site’s data in your browser. You can also restrict cookies in browser settings; some site features may then be limited.

sections.title: 6. More information
sections.body: See also our Privacy policy. Contact: contact@cobreo.ca

about.title: About Cobreo
about.metaDescription: Cobreo builds custom applications that simplify day-to-day work and support operations.
about.heroBody: Cobreo builds custom applications. We analyze your operations, design the tool, then develop it with concrete deliverables at each step.
about.originBody1: Across our careers, we often saw solid companies slowed down by heavy processes, manual work, and tools that don’t quite fit how they operate.
about.originBody2: We built Cobreo to help those teams spot where they can save time, then build simple tools that fit day-to-day work. AI tools help us explore and prototype faster, while we keep control over decisions and the quality of the result.
about.foundersBody: A small team united by the aim of making day-to-day work simpler and more useful.
about.founder1Bio: Product, design, and development. Clarifying the need, prototyping quickly, and shipping tools teams want to use.
about.founder1Experience: Background in development and design, notably in health and education.
about.founder2Bio: Development and delivery. Turning clear intent into a reliable, maintainable solution that fits day-to-day work.
about.founder2Experience: Background in finance, hospitality, and automation.
about.approachTitle: Move faster without giving up on quality.
about.approachBody: Our experience in design and development helps us know where to focus. AI tools let us explore, prototype, and validate more quickly. We use them as an accelerator while keeping control over decisions, design, and final product quality.
about.workBody: We look first for where the gain is clearest, validate the approach before building, then deliver a tool tailored to your operations and keep evolving it with you.
about.ctaBody: A short conversation to clarify your priorities and see how we can help.
